_about: Coverage checklist for the small task (storage conditions). One entry per required detail. priority = criticality (1-3) x (1 - guessability, 0-1), set by hand once (LHAW) and reviewed by the team before any scoring. present_in = prompt versions whose text states the detail. Hidden questions (H1-H7) are in no version: the agent must ask or guess them. See METRICS.md, section 1.
status: draft: values proposed 2026-11-16, not yet reviewed by the team

details.detail: What to build: one storage-conditions field on the product (not an attribute, metadata or a label)
Who uses it: staff set it, customers read it
In the API, webhook payloads and CSV export; no filter or search
Definition of done: end to end, tests in place, everything passes locally
Existing products: empty by default, schema migration only, no backfill
Example value: "Keep refrigerated at 2-8 °C" (short free text)
Plain text, optional, max 250 characters, empty allowed
Staff set it on the product in the dashboard
Customers see it in the product description on the storefront
Shown only on the product page, not in cart, checkout or emails
Translatable like the product name and description
details.source: hidden 2; stated in v5 ("It must be translatable"), where K2 contradicts it

contradictions.side_a: customers should see it where relevant
contradictions.side_b: Keep it internal: customers must never see it
contradictions.resolution: Customers see it on the storefront product page (hidden 4). Side A wins.
contradictions.check_side_a: storefront product page shows the value

contradictions.side_b: Only English is needed, no translations
contradictions.resolution: It is translatable like the product name and description (hidden 2). Side A wins.
contradictions.check_side_a: translation support in API and dashboard
